# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.11 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.10`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Uses the same dark EnterpriseGlue layout for sign-in, organization selection, and first-login password reset.
- **frontend:** Starts the dashboard with embedded deployment configuration and reduces project-discovery queries for pooled tenants.

## User and administrator impact

- The Cloud Login page and organization picker use the dark illustrated layout already used for signup, direct organization sign-in, and recovery. The Login form matches the password-reset form width.
- A deployment that supplies the configuration in the initial page can start the dashboard without a separate configuration request.
- Pooled workspaces determine the visible project set in fewer database round trips.

## API and integration compatibility

- The application shell reserves metadata for the standard same-origin runtime configuration document.

## Configuration

- The existing runtime configuration endpoint remains the fallback for unmodified application shells and custom configuration URLs.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The embedded document uses the same validation and API and system module startup checks as the fetched document.
- Pooled project discovery remains bound to the request tenant and PostgreSQL row-level security.

## Documentation

- Release notes describe the shared appearance across EnterpriseGlue sign-in screens.
- The deployment configuration reference describes when the application can use runtime configuration from its HTML response.

## Rollback

- Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
- Redeploy the preceding compatible application image; the original runtime configuration endpoint remains available.

## Validation evidence

- Browser checks cover dark sign-in surfaces, mobile and zoom reflow, and the persistent header during organization selection.
- Frontend runtime configuration tests and production dashboard cold and warm load comparisons.
- Pooled PostgreSQL dashboard checks for an owner and member with separate project access.
